title: The Dark Truth About Re:Zero (TV series) #Shorts
description:
Reproduction explains more of Re:Zero (TV series) than any philosophy dares to admit. It premiered on 4 April 2016 and has aired four seasons across television networks such as TV Tokyo, TV Osaka, TV Aichi, and AT-X. The series has been streamed by Crunchyroll outside Asia, which released the anime on home media in the United States and through Anime Limited in the United Kingdom.

Re:Zero (TV series) did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. The second season's first opening theme song is "Realize", performed by Konomi Suzuki, while the first ending theme song is "Memento", performed by Nonoc. The second season's second opening theme song is "Long Shot", performed by Mayu Maeshima, while the second ending theme song is "Believe in You", performed by Nonoc.
